result.instructions: Tools for Giftbit, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which reward brands can I order in the US, and what are their price limits?"; "Show me the rewards we sent last week and which ones are still unclaimed."; "Send a 25 USD Amazon reward by email to jane@example.com (I will confirm the details first).". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Giftbit data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run giftbit_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run giftbit_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run giftbit_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. giftbit_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: giftbit_list_brands
tools.title: List reward brands
tools.description: List reward brands with brand_code, name, image and allowed price. Use the brand_code in an order. Filter by region, currency, price range, search text or embeddable. GET /brands.

search.description: Search text in the brand name.

embeddable.description: Only brands usable for embedded rewards.

tools.name: giftbit_get_brand
tools.title: Get a reward brand
tools.description: Get extended information for one brand: allowed prices, terms and disclaimer. GET /brands/{brand_code}.

tools.name: giftbit_list_regions
tools.title: List regions
tools.description: List the regions. A region id filters brands and requests a Full Catalog reward (every brand in the region). GET /regions.

tools.name: giftbit_list_rewards
tools.title: List rewards
tools.description: List rewards ordered earlier through the API, with recipient, price, brand, delivery and redemption status. Dates are Pacific time. GET /gifts.

recipient_email.description: Only rewards for this recipient email.

campaign_id.description: Only rewards of this order id.

created_date_greater_than.description: Created on or after this date.

tools.name: giftbit_get_reward
tools.title: Get a reward
tools.description: Get one reward by its uuid: recipient, price, brand, delivery and redemption status. GET /gifts/{uuid}.

uuid.description: The reward uuid (from giftbit_list_rewards or an order response).

tools.name: giftbit_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get the status of an order (email or shortlink), with its contacts, price, brand codes and delivery counts. GET /campaign/{id}.

id.description: The order id you supplied, or the order uuid Giftbit assigned.

tools.name: giftbit_get_link_urls
tools.title: Get link URLs
tools.description: Get the claim URLs of a shortlink or direct link order. The URLs are ready a short time after the order. GET /links/{id}.

id.description: The client-provided id of the link order.

tools.name: giftbit_get_funds
tools.title: Get account funds
tools.description: Get the account balance by currency. Adding funds is not offered here: do it in the Giftbit web interface. GET /funds.

tools.name: giftbit_create_email_reward
tools.title: Order an email reward
tools.description: ORDERS A REWARD AND CHARGES THE ACCOUNT. Giftbit emails the reward to one recipient. Give brand_codes, region or gift_template, plus price_in_cents. Without gift_template, message and subject are required. In Testbed the email goes to the account owner, not the recipient. POST /campaign.

order_id.description: Your unique id for this order. Reuse it only to retry the same order; a new id makes a new order.

price_in_cents.description: Reward value in cents, for example 2500 for 25.00.

brand_codes.description: One or more brand_code values from giftbit_list_brands. Several codes let the recipient pick one.

region.description: Region id for a Full Catalog reward (from giftbit_list_regions).

gift_template.description: Giftbit template id (uppercase identifier from the web interface).

expiry.description: Last claim date (yyyy-mm-dd, at most one year away). Makes a promotional reward.

brand_codes.description: Echo of brand_codes, in the same order.

recipient_email.description: Echo of the recipient email address.

firstname.description: Echo of the recipient first name.

lastname.description: Echo of the recipient last name.

confirm.description: Repeat the order values exactly (brand, price, recipient, count). Show these values to the user and get their OK first.

tools.name: giftbit_create_shortlink_order
tools.title: Order shortlink rewards
tools.description: ORDERS REWARDS AND CHARGES THE ACCOUNT. Creates shortlink rewards (landing-page links) that you distribute yourself. No recipient is needed. Set link_count. Read them with giftbit_get_link_urls. POST /campaign with delivery_type SHORTLINK.
